traditional: 返 + 嚟／去 + 同 A 一齊
jyutping: faan2 lai4 heoi3 tung4 A jat1 cai4

english.note: Use this when someone comes or goes back to be with a particular person again; choose 嚟 toward the speaker and 去 away from the speaker.

examples.english: Come back and rejoin me for dinner after work.
examples.traditional: 你放工就返嚟同我一齊食飯啦。
examples.jyutping: nei5 fong3 gung1 zau6 faan1 lai4 tung4 ngo5 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6 laa1
